description: Get a single branch's detail, including its head commit's coverage totals. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/repos/{repo_name}/branches/{name}/.

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

name: codecov_get_branch
title: Get branch
